description: Test file containing mocks for remote cluster services in the Mattermost project, including mock server, app, and store implementations used for unit testing.

classes.name: mockServer
classes.description: Mock implementation of a server for remote cluster testing, with methods to set user, retrieve store, and manage cluster state.

classes.name: mockApp
classes.description: Mock application simulating shared channels ping behavior, tracking ping counts and errors for testing.

methods.name: SetUser
methods.description: Sets the user for the mock server.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns server configuration, here always nil.

methods.name: GetMetrics
methods.description: Returns server metrics interface, here always nil.

methods.name: IsLeader
methods.description: Indicates if the server is a leader, always true in mock.

methods.name: AddClusterLeaderChangedListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for cluster leader changes, returns a new ID.

methods.name: RemoveClusterLeaderChangedListener
methods.description: Removes a cluster leader change listener.

methods.name: GetStore
methods.description: Returns the store, either custom or default mock with predefined behaviors.

methods.name: OnSharedChannelsPing
methods.description: Simulates a ping to shared channels, tracking success or error based on plugin ID.

methods.name: GetPingCount
methods.description: Returns ping count for a specific plugin ID.
